name: Teriyaki & Wok
why: Capitol Hill Seattle Blog (Nov 2025) reported the Teriyaki & Wok corner space on Broadway became Birrieria Jalisco #1. CHS returned 403 to our fetcher, so this was read from the search-result summary; supporting: the shop's own ordering page (teriyakiandwok.smartonlineorder.com) said 'currently closed' on 2026-10-05 and its website is frozen at copyright 2023.
